# Public payment-code vectors

`quais-payments.json` is generated by `../generate-fixtures.mjs` against locked
`quais@1.0.0-alpha.57`. It contains only public toy seeds and their deterministic
notification/payment keys, codes, raw addresses and first valid Qi/zone indices.
Both JS sender and recipient derivation paths are checked during generation.

`bip47-published.json` transcribes factual cryptographic test data from the
SamouraiDev BIP47 vectors at gist revision
`beddb67cf219ead27b8b1380a3b084b8dde51093`:
https://gist.github.com/SamouraiDev/6aad669604c5930864bd/beddb67cf219ead27b8b1380a3b084b8dde51093
It retains source attribution and contains no copied implementation or prose.
The listed "shared secrets" are raw ECDH X coordinates, before SHA256. Bitcoin
coin-zero address construction is confined to the independent reference test.

Never fund any seed/key/code in either fixture. These are offline compatibility
vectors, not node transaction-acceptance or live notification tests.
